selections.heading: Way of Working
selections.text: Define delivery personas by distinct operational goals and permission contexts rather than creating one persona for every job title; do not introduce personas for explicitly out-of-scope administration surfaces.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Keep release-wide or intent-wide acceptance matrices outside the INVEST user-story count; represent them as explicit exit gates and keep the counted stories small and actor-valued.

selections.heading: Testing Posture
selections.text: Use one explicitly inherited cross-cutting acceptance contract for accessibility, security, resilience, and evidence when repeating it in every story would obscure actor value; never postpone those NFRs into a late quality-only story.

selections.heading: Contract Evolution
selections.text: Keep unsupported provider controls and missing canonical identifiers as named dependencies with owners and exit conditions rather than implementation stories; a story cannot promise actor value the approved provider contract cannot deliver.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: When a desired command is blocked by an unadmitted contract exit, keep the command absent in current acceptance and write a current actor-valued story such as truthful recovery; post-exit behavior stays in change-controlled backlog scope until admitted.
